## Response

**201** — api.BranchProtection

- **400** — Both rule_name and branch_name are empty
- **403** — Branch protection already exists for this rule name
- **404** — Repository not found
- **422** — User or team in whitelist does not exist
- **423** — Repository is archived

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Rule name must not be empty - either rule_name or branch_name must be provided | validation | len(ruleName) == 0 |
| Branch protection rule must not already exist for the same repo and rule name | validation | protectBranch != nil (already exists) |
| Whitelist users must have write access to the code unit to be added to push/force-push/merge whitelists | authorization | !perm.CanWrite(unit.TypeCode) |
| Approval whitelist users must have at least read access to the pull requests unit | authorization | !prUserIDs.Contains(userID) |
| Auto-priority calculation: new rules get MAX(priority)+1 if priority is not explicitly set | business_logic | protectBranch.ID == 0 && protectBranch.Priority == 0 |
| EnableWhitelist is only true if both EnablePush AND EnablePushWhitelist are true | business_logic | form.EnablePush && form.EnablePushWhitelist |
